regra: ASCII puro. Nao encurtar nomes de item (linhas curtas); cortar so descricao. Preservar nomes proprios e o sentido.

itens.jp: 敵を回転の衝撃で斬り上げ、閃光の突きで攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that slashes enemies skyward with spinning impacts and strikes with flashing thrusts.

itens.jp: 左右の斬撃後、地面を叩き衝撃波で追い打ちする秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that follows left and right slashes by slamming the ground to strike with shockwaves.

itens.jp: 高速移動と共に敵を貫き返りの空中斬りに巻き込む奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that impales enemies while moving at high speed, drawing them into aerial slashes.

itens.jp: 空中から冷気の槍で敵を貫き、着地後さらに突く秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that impales foes from midair with freezing spears and thrusts again upon landing.

itens.jp: 炎を纏った拳で敵を払い斬撃をあびせる奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that sweeps enemies away with flame-cloaked fists and showers them with slashes.

itens.jp: 間合いを詰めつつ鬼炎斬と鬼炎連脚を繰り出す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that closes distance while unleashing Demon Flame Slash and Demon Flame Barrage.

itens.jp: 臥竜閃後、更に空中で二撃の真空波を繰り出す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that follows Crouching Dragon Flash with two more vacuum wave strikes in midair.

itens.jp: 敵の背後に回る特性を持つ二連突きを繰り出す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that executes a two-stage thrust featuring the ability to slip behind the enemy.

itens.jp: 一定の確率で短時間敵の防御力を下げる札を飛ばす秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that flings a talisman reducing enemy defense for a short time with a set chance.

itens.jp: 一定の確率で短時間敵の敏捷を下げる札を飛ばす秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that flings a talisman reducing enemy agility for a short time with a set chance.

itens.jp: 天高く浮かし、すかさず槍で突き更に叩き落とす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies sky-high, impales them with a spear, and slams them down.

itens.jp: 無数の突きから斬り上げ、烈空斬と魔神剣で追撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches upward from rapid thrusts and chases with Tempest and Demon Fang.

itens.jp: 一定の確率で短時間敵の攻撃力を下げる札を飛ばす秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that flings a talisman reducing enemy attack for a short time with a set chance.

itens.jp: 敵の懐に入り、強烈な斬撃を繰り出しダウンさせる奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that enters the enemy's pocket and delivers heavy slashes, knocking them down.

itens.jp: 神の住まう天空から割砕するは人。すなわち俺奥義
itens.en: From the heavens where God resides, what shatters is person. In other words, Me: Arcane Arte.

itens.jp: 異世界とコンタクトを取る為に使う鍵。今は魔力を失っているようだ
itens.en: A key used to make contact with other worlds. It seems to have lost its magic power for now.

itens.jp: 敵を回転斬りにより巻き込み闘気を叩き付ける奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that draws enemies into a spinning slash and slams them with fighting spirit.

itens.jp: 地面に槍を突き立てた衝撃で旋風が渦巻く奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte where whirlwinds vortex from the impact of thrusting a spear into the ground.

itens.jp: 遠距離から水蛇の様に絡む連撃で敵を引き寄せる秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that draws in enemies with long-range combo strikes coiling like water snakes.

itens.jp: 弧月斬で斬り上げ、浮いた敵を烈空斬で追撃する秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that slashes upward with Crescent Slash and chases airborne foes with Tempest.

itens.jp: 懐に潜り込み水圧射撃を放ち、間合いを開ける奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that dives into the pocket, fires water pressure shots, and creates distance.

itens.jp: 執拗に破かれた手紙。字は読めないが、怨念が読み取れる
itens.en: A letter persistently torn to shreds. The writing is illegible, but the grudge is palpable.

itens.jp: 銭を生む紙。ある意味で一番恐ろしいモンスターだと言える
itens.en: Paper that breeds money. In a sense, it could be called the most terrifying monster of all.

itens.jp: 大地に眠る凍気を解放し、巨大な氷矢で攻撃する術
itens.en: An arte that releases freezing energy asleep in the earth to strike with a giant ice arrow.

itens.jp: 一定の確率で短時間敵の防御力を下げる札を貼る特技
itens.en: A skill that attaches a talisman reducing enemy defense for a short time with a set chance.

itens.jp: 一定の確率で短時間敵の敏捷を下げる札を貼る特技
itens.en: A skill that attaches a talisman reducing enemy agility for a short time with a set chance.

itens.jp: 意志を持つ無機物をあるべき姿に戻す無限の短剣奥義
itens.en: An infinite dagger arcane arte that restores conscious inorganic matter to its proper form.

itens.jp: 神の力で飛び散る水や跳ねる油から人を守る。着脱可能
itens.en: Protects the wearer from splattering water and spitting oil with divine power. Detachable.

itens.jp: 職人が活火山の中で命がけで作る温泉卵。それなりに美味い
itens.en: A hot spring egg risking life and limb to make inside an active volcano. Reasonably tasty.

itens.jp: 鏡面に前の持ち主が引っかいてつけた眼の模様がついている
itens.en: The mirror's surface bears the pattern of an eye, scratched into it by its previous owner.

itens.jp: 敵を浮かせた状態で高速回転斬りを行う秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that executes high-speed spinning slashes while juggling enemies in the air.

itens.jp: 敵を突き上げ、炎を纏い急降下攻撃後ダウンさせる奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that thrusts enemies skyward, cloaks in flame, dives, and knocks them down.

itens.jp: 雷撃と共に打ち上げた後、鉱石を跳ね上げ追撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies with lightning, then tosses up minerals to follow up.

itens.jp: 連続回転しながらチャクラムで周囲の敵を攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that attacks surrounding enemies with chakrams while continuously spinning.

itens.jp: 一定の確率で短時間敵の攻撃力を下げる札を貼る特技
itens.en: A skill that attaches a talisman reducing enemy attack for a short time with a set chance.

itens.jp: 剣による連撃で敵を斬り上げ、帯刀状態へ移行する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies with sword combos and transitions to sheathed stance.

itens.jp: 封印された地の扉を開く鍵。所々欠けているので使用不可能
itens.en: A key that unlocks the door to the sealed land. Chipped in places and currently unusable.

itens.jp: 灼熱弾が意思を持つが如く敵に炸裂する火系の術
itens.en: A fire arte where scalding orbs detonate on enemies as if possessing a will of their own.

itens.jp: 瞬時に間合いを詰めて殴り続け、敵を打ち上げる奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that closes distance instantly, striking repeatedly and launching enemies.

itens.jp: 轟破槍から追撃で前後に衝撃波を放つ奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that follows Roaring Spear with shockwaves unleashed forward and backward.

itens.jp: 敵を打ち上げ、爆炎を纏った突きによって追撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies skyward and follows up with explosive flame thrusts.

itens.jp: 後書きによれば決定版らしいが、今夏続刊発売が決定
itens.en: The afterword calls this the definitive edition, but a sequel already ships this summer.

itens.jp: なぜか以前からバンエルティア号の部屋に置いてあった宝玉
itens.en: A jewel that, for some reason, had been left in a room on the Van Eltia for a long time.

itens.jp: 対象となる敵の地面から無数の泡を出現させる術
itens.en: An arte that causes countless bubbles to surge from the ground beneath the target enemy.

itens.jp: 一定時間、味方単体の状態異常、状態変化を防ぐ術
itens.en: An arte that prevents status ailments and stat debuffs for a single ally for a set time.

itens.jp: 炎を纏った闘気を敵にぶつけて攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that attacks enemies by slamming them with flame-cloaked fighting spirit.

itens.jp: 常人の目には見切れぬ高速移動を伴った斬撃奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte with high-speed movement slashes that cannot be tracked by ordinary eyes.

itens.jp: 連続攻撃で空中に打ち上げ、真空の刃で叩き落す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies with combos and slams them down with vacuum blades.

itens.jp: 突進後、敵を打ち上げ、連続で斬撃を繰り出す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that rushes forward, launches enemies, and unleashes consecutive slashes.

itens.jp: あふれる気合を露骨に叩き付ける爆烈奥義
itens.en: An explosive arcane arte that explicitly slams overflowing fighting spirit into enemies.

itens.jp: 闇走破の後、地面から雷を呼び出し攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that calls up lightning from the ground to attack after Shadow Run Blast.

itens.jp: 足元を払い斬りし、斬り上げた敵に爆風で追い打つ奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that sweeps enemy feet, launching and following up with explosive blasts.

itens.jp: 味方全員のＨＰを中程度回復する術（戦闘中は範囲）
itens.en: An arte that restores a moderate amount of HP to all allies (area of effect in battle).

itens.jp: 一定時間、味方の物理攻撃上昇、状態異常を回復する術
itens.en: An arte that raises an ally's physical attack and cures status ailments for a set time.

itens.jp: 素早い突進から連続で敵を斬り上げ攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that rushes forward swiftly and attacks with consecutive upward slashes.

itens.jp: 弧月閃から斬り上げと斬り下ろしの二段斬りを繰り出す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that executes upward and downward two-stage slashes from Crescent Flash.

itens.jp: 四連続の回転斬りで周囲の敵を攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that attacks surrounding enemies with four consecutive spinning slashes.

itens.jp: 敵を斬り上げ、高速移動で斬撃を重ねる奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that slashes enemies skyward, stacking slashes with high-speed movement.

itens.jp: 衝撃波を起こし、浮かせた敵にストレートを見舞う奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that conjures shockwaves and delivers a straight punch to airborne foes.

itens.jp: 水の流れの如く連続で斬り、衝撃波で止めを刺す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that slashes continuously like flowing water, finishing with shockwaves.

itens.jp: 雷撃で浮かせ巨大な鋼を具現化させて敵へと落とす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches with lightning and drops giant manifested steel onto foes.

itens.jp: 強力な突きにより生じた風圧で敵を攻撃する秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that attacks enemies with air pressure generated from a powerful thrust.

itens.jp: 重い突きで敵の動きを止め、渾身の力で打ち上げる秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that halts enemy movement with a heavy thrust and launches them skyward.

itens.jp: 斬撃で打ち上げた後に三連撃を繰り出す秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that launches enemies with slashes and follows with three combo strikes.

itens.jp: 瞬時に間合いを詰めながら、一閃を繰り出す秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that delivers a single sword flash while closing distance in an instant.

itens.jp: 地面に槍を突き刺し水柱を発生させ敵を攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that thrusts a spear into the ground, raising a water pillar to attack.

itens.jp: 衝撃波を伴った斬りで浮かした敵を、叩き斬る奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies with shockwave slashes and slams down with a cut.

itens.jp: 敵を浮かせた後、空中で回し蹴りと斬撃を叩き込む奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies, then lands spinning kicks and slashes in midair.

itens.jp: 敵を盾の一撃で打ち上げ鋭い突きで追い討ちする奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies with a shield bash and chases with sharp thrusts.

itens.jp: 神速の斬り上げから蹴り上げる事で敵を天に飛ばす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies sky-high from godspeed upward slashes into kicks.

itens.jp: 跳躍して矢を放ち、敵がその位置に来ると爆発する特技
itens.en: A skill that leaps and fires arrows that detonate when enemies approach that position.

itens.jp: 空中からの一撃で砕いた地面の破片で敵を射抜く秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that snipes enemies with ground fragments shattered from aerial strikes.

itens.jp: 連続斬り後、雷を纏った斬撃で敵を薙ぎ払う奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that sweeps enemies away with lightning slashes after consecutive cuts.

itens.jp: 敵を打ち上げ回転斬りで上昇後、衝撃波を放つ奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches enemies, ascends with spinning slashes, and fires blasts.

itens.jp: 自らの闘気を爆発させ周囲の敵を吹き飛ばす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that detonates one's own fighting spirit to blow away surrounding foes.

itens.jp: 最高級のんまぁ〜い料理。一口食べれば号泣する美味しさ
itens.en: A supreme, scrumptious dish. So delicious that a single bite will bring you to tears.

itens.jp: 一定時間、味方の物理防御上昇、状態変化を回復する術
itens.en: An arte that raises an ally's physical defense and cures stat debuffs for a set time.

itens.jp: 炎の闘気を纏い鳳凰の如く、急降下攻撃をする奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that cloaks oneself in flame fighting spirit and dives like a phoenix.

itens.jp: 滅翔槍の後、地面から竜巻を起こし追撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that follows Flying Ruin Spear by conjuring tornadoes from the ground.

itens.jp: 天に向かって五発の冷気を纏った矢を同時に放つ奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that fires five cold-cloaked arrows simultaneously toward the heavens.

itens.jp: 突きの後、大地を揺るがす拳で突き上げる秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that follows a thrust with a skyward fist strike that shakes the earth.

itens.jp: 剣圧で敵を浮かせその後、上空で薙ぎ払う奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that lifts enemies with sword pressure and sweeps them away in midair.

itens.jp: 斬り上げと斬り下ろしの二段斬りから真空破を出す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that releases vacuum waves from two-stage upward and downward slashes.

itens.jp: 回転体当たりで所構わず吹き飛ばす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that blows everything away indiscriminately with a spinning body slam.

itens.jp: 斬り払いから斬り上げの連続攻撃を行う特技
itens.en: A skill that executes consecutive attacks from a clearing slash into an upward slash.

itens.jp: 振り下ろしから敵を引き込み、突進で追い詰める奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that pulls enemies in from a downward swing and closes in with a rush.

itens.jp: 闇走破の後、地面から炎を呼び出し攻撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that calls up flames from the ground to attack after Shadow Run Blast.

itens.jp: 斧で叩き剣で突き、さらに武器を交差して斬り払う奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that strikes with an axe, thrusts with a sword, and cleaves crosswise.

itens.jp: 雷の力を込めた短剣を放射状に放ち落雷させる秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that fires lightning-imbued daggers radially to call down thunderbolts.

itens.jp: 吹くと衝撃波で半径１００メートル以内の窓ガラスを全部割ってしまう
itens.en: Blowing it creates a shockwave that shatters every window within a 100-meter radius.

itens.jp: 武器を振り回し闘気と共に敵を薙ぎ払う奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that swings weapons to sweep enemies away along with fighting spirit.

itens.jp: 地面に剣を突き刺し、衝撃で岩の槍を召喚する特技
itens.en: A skill that thrusts a sword into the ground, summoning rock lances with shockwaves.

itens.jp: 敵の頭上に瞬間移動し、炎を宿した斬撃を行う秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that teleports above the enemy's head to deliver flame-imbued slashes.

itens.jp: 斬り下ろしから打ち上げ、回転斬りで追撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that slashes down, launches up, and follows up with spinning slashes.

itens.jp: 閃光と共に近所の奥様に公開不能なアレコレをする奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that, amidst a flash, does unmentionable things to neighboring wives.

itens.jp: 狼の形をした闘気を敵に叩き付け吹き飛ばす秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that slams wolf-shaped fighting spirit into enemies to blow them away.

itens.jp: 高速の剣戟を重ね、絶風の衝撃波を生み出す奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that stacks high-speed sword clashes to produce windstorm shockwaves.

itens.jp: 一定時間、対象敵１体の仰け反り時間を増加する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that increases stagger time for a single target enemy for a set time.

itens.jp: アッパーと謎の三角蹴りで敵を吹き飛ばす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that blows enemies away with uppercuts and mysterious triangle kicks.

itens.jp: 突きからの鋭い２連続の剣撃で衝撃を放つ奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that unleashes shockwaves from two sharp sword strikes after thrusts.

itens.jp: 上空へ斬り上げた敵を強烈な一閃で天に縛り付ける奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that binds upward-slashed enemies to the heavens with a fierce flash.

itens.jp: 猛る炎が龍と化し、己を包み敵を討つ奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte where raging flames turn to dragons, enveloping self to slay enemies.

itens.jp: 回転斬りによって竜巻を生じさせつつ斬り上げる秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that slashes upward while generating a tornado with a spinning slash.

itens.jp: 剣圧で敵を浮かせ、その後止めの一撃を繰り出す秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that lifts enemies with sword pressure and delivers a finishing blow.

itens.jp: 敵を振り払いながら、奥の敵に突きを加える奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that thrusts at enemies in the back while sweeping aside front foes.

itens.jp: 不意打ち後、鉱石を跳ね上げて敵を吹き飛ばす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that launches minerals after a surprise strike to blow enemies away.

itens.jp: 直進する一発の矢と誘導する四発の矢を同時に放つ奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that fires one straight arrow and four homing arrows simultaneously.

itens.jp: 爆突襲撃後、敵の足下に五つのお土産を置いていく奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that leaves five presents at enemy feet after Explosive Thrust Raid.

itens.jp: 左右の斬撃後、後ろ回し蹴りをお見舞いする特技
itens.en: A skill that delivers left and right slashes followed by a reverse roundhouse kick.

itens.jp: 溜めた気合いを相手に放出することでダウンさせる特技
itens.en: A skill that knocks down opponents by releasing gathered fighting spirit into them.

itens.jp: 閃走牙・刹月華・滅掌破を組合わせた奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that combines Flashing Fang, Severing Moon Flower, and Ruinous Palm.

itens.jp: 斬り上げた剣を斬り下ろし三日月の軌道を描く秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that slashes upward and downward, tracing a crescent moon trajectory.

itens.jp: キックから水属性の弾丸で追撃し吹き飛ばす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that follows a kick with water-element bullets to blow enemies away.

itens.jp: 天地猛爪撃で吹き飛ばした後、魔神剣で追撃する奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that blows enemies away with Fierce Claw and chases with Demon Fang.

itens.jp: 炎を纏う拳で殴った後、周囲に溶岩を湧き立たせる奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that punches with a flame-cloaked fist and boils up lava all around.

itens.jp: 雷を呼んで敵を打ち、さらに雷で追撃する秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that summons thunder to strike enemies and follows up with lightning.

itens.jp: 跳躍から垂直に落下し、着地の衝撃で攻撃する秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that drops vertically from a leap and attacks with impact on landing.

itens.jp: 小太刀で斬り上げた敵を空中で何度も斬り付ける秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that repeatedly slashes airborne foes in midair after upward slashes.

itens.jp: 天を舞う様に敵を斬り裂きながら、大きく移動する特技
itens.en: A skill that moves broadly while slicing enemies as if dancing through the heavens.

itens.jp: ツバメが舞うが如く敵を斬り最後に敵を蹴り上げる特技
itens.en: A skill that slashes enemies like a fluttering swallow, kicking them up at the end.

itens.jp: 猛虎を屠る獅子の咆哮で敵を吹き飛ばす秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that blows enemies away with lion roars that slaughter fierce tigers.

itens.jp: 書き込みスペースが真っ白で、見るとアンニュイな気持ちになる
itens.en: The writing spaces are stark white; looking at it fills one with a sense of ennui.

itens.jp: 暗がりを照らすのに使う。オイルだからと変な事に使ってはいけない
itens.en: Used to illuminate dark places. Being oil is no excuse to use it for weird things.

itens.en: Slime extracted from a Polwiggle. Used in medicine, cosmetics, and industry alike.

itens.jp: 対象となる敵の地面から鋭利な氷の塊を発生させる術

itens.jp: 対象の足元に重力場を発生させ天高く跳ね上げる術
itens.en: An arte that creates a gravity field at the target's feet to launch them sky-high.

itens.en: A skill that slams a hammer into enemies with a high probability of stunning them.

itens.jp: 敵を吹き飛ばす障壁を展開しつつ味方を微回復する特技
itens.en: A skill that deploys a barrier blowing enemies away while slightly healing allies.

itens.jp: 炎の闘気を纏った剣で周囲の敵を焼き払う奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that scorches surrounding enemies with a sword cloaked in flame qi.

itens.jp: 超遠心力（怪）から究極パンチを繰り出す特技
itens.en: A skill that delivers an ultimate punch from super centrifugal force (mysterious).

itens.jp: 敵の上空に射撃した矢を炸裂させて真下の敵を狙う特技

itens.jp: 剣戟と旋風で斬り裂き、さらに旋風を叩き付ける秘技

itens.en: A favorite item of an unfortunate girl. She is still alive, so there is no curse.

itens.jp: 大人になると中身が充実していき、次第に面倒になってくる

itens.en: Doctors use it to hear heartbeats. By rule, if pointed at you, you must undress.

itens.jp: 不幸な事故に遭った女性の一品。現在は新調したらしい
itens.en: Belonged to a woman who met an unfortunate mishap. She's since bought a new one.

itens.jp: 対象となる敵の周辺から大量の水流を出現させる術

itens.jp: 神速の突きにより突風が巻き起こり敵を吹き飛ばす奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte where godspeed thrusts stir up sudden gusts to blow enemies away.

itens.jp: 間合い詰め時にボムスロー、その後突きを繰り出す秘技
itens.en: A secret arte that throws bombs while closing distance and then thrusts forward.

itens.en: A skill that fires consecutive kicks pivoting on a sword thrust into the ground.

itens.en: An arcane arte that delivers aerial kicks and connects into consecutive attacks.

itens.en: Many women drink this as a sleep aid to end the day feeling true to themselves.

itens.en: In exchange for summer vacation memories, it can be wielded as a lethal weapon.

itens.en: An arte that slightly restores TP of allies in range and cures status ailments.

itens.jp: 斬り下ろしから斬り上げへと繋げる二段斬りを行う特技
itens.en: A skill that executes a two-stage slash connecting downward and upward slashes.

itens.en: A secret arte that slashes enemies sky-high, delivering dive kicks and slashes.

itens.en: An arcane arte that unleashes earth-cleaving slashes after consecutive attacks.

itens.en: A secret arte that dances into the air and fires twelve bullets while spinning.

itens.jp: 炎の力を一気に解放しながら敵を薙ぎ払う秘技

itens.jp: 突きの後、雷撃と風圧での追撃を行う奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that follows a thrust with lightning and wind pressure strikes.

itens.jp: 地面に着弾した矢の衝撃で岩の塊を発生させる特技

itens.jp: 踏み込み斬りを繰り出し、斬撃の衝撃波で追撃する奥義

itens.jp: 双旋牙と臥龍撃を組合わせた奥義
itens.en: An arcane arte that combines Twin Spinning Fangs and Crouching Dragon Strike.

itens.jp: 敵の懐に素早く潜り、豪快に吹き飛ばす秘技
